Thanks to EufyMake E1 for sponsoring today's video. Sign up now to receive a limited-time exclusive gift worth over $600 and get a reminder for the in-stock launch on May 6: https://eufymake.sjv.io/yZyaNV

One of the replica collections Adam has been building is a set of famous gemstones, both historical and fictional. Part of the process of organizing the pieces of that collection is arranging them in foamcore and visualizing their layout and their display possibilities. Adam makes a prototype display box for one of these cubic zirconia pieces, using the Eufymake E1 UV printer to make a perfect label for it!
